legend.hint: Colour tells the region; the angle of the hatching tells the civilizations within it apart.

detail.handDrawn: Outline drawn by hand for this atlas: the source does not carry this realm.
detail.carried: The source does not map this realm in {{year}}; the line comes from {{from}}, {{years}} years away.
detail.absent: No border mapped in this century. Drag the year to {{peak}}, this civilization's height.
detail.sharedHint: Only contemporaries belong here: whoever shared ground with this civilization in this same century. A
detail.sharedAbbr: the source does not map one of the two in this century, and the line came from the nearest slice
detail.sharedHintTail: marks a measure taken against a border borrowed from another century.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the world is drawn
settings.projectionHint: No projection is neutral. The areas in the panels are measured on the sphere when the data is built, so switching here changes the drawing and no number.
settings.creditsRest: (GPL-3.0) · coastline from Natural Earth · Wonders and emblems from the Age of Empires Series Wiki · geometry cut on {{date}}

equal-earth.caveat: Areas can be compared by eye. Shapes near the edges lean.

natural-earth.caveat: A pleasant compromise: it keeps neither area nor angle true, and errs little in both.

mercator.caveat: Familiar, but it inflates whatever is far from the equator. Compare sizes by the numbers.

errors.slice: This century could not be loaded.
